matcher_config.guardrail: Auto matches are ranked research candidates. They never overwrite curated evidence automatically.

scoring_config.name: Evidence Quality Scoring (not prophet ranking)
scoring_config.semantic: Scores measure strength, provenance, consistency, and reproducibility of claims. They do not measure prophetic rank or divine truth.
scoring_config.aggregation: weighted geometric mean with equal default component weights
scoring_config.probability_guardrail: Raw score is not a probability. Probability output is forbidden until empirical calibration against labeled benchmark data.

world_trait_research.guardrail: This layer scores research salience of textually mapped traits, not holiness, moral rank, or human worth.
world_trait_research.via_reliability_source: VIA Institute VIA-IS-R psychometrics (McGrath 2017 technical report)
world_trait_research.moral_valuation_source: Stahlmann & Ruch 2020, Frontiers in Psychology: all 24 strengths positively morally valued; top five judgment, honesty, kindness, fairness, hope.
world_trait_research.prevalence_source: Park, Peterson & Seligman 2006: 117,676 adults, 54 nations; common strengths kindness, fairness, honesty, gratitude, judgment.
world_trait_research.schwartz_source: Schwartz et al. 2012 refined theory of 19 basic values; used for classification only, not numerical preference.
world_trait_research.outcome_source: 2026 meta-analysis of 114 RCTs/20,853 participants on selected strengths and well-being; used as annotation only, not score weight.
world_trait_research.scoring_formula: WORLD_SALIENCE = 100 * Σ[top-2 contributions] / 4, contribution = textual_strength * mapping_confidence * VIA_alpha * (moral_top5 + prevalence_top5). At least 2 curated mappings required. Adding another mapped trait cannot lower the score.

context_scoring_config.name: CONTEXT_EVIDENCE_SCORE
context_scoring_config.guardrail: Measures documentation/provenance quality, not superiority of religion, people, region, language, or prophet.
